subject.title: fix(update): backport JSON resume isolation to 2026.7.2

question: Should the release maintainers include the already-merged JSON-resume isolation fix in the `2026.7.2` release branch?
rationale: The patch is a focused copy of current-main behavior, but selecting fixes for a release branch is a release-owner decision rather than an automated cleanup action.

options.title: Include the tested backport
options.body: Merge this exact cherry-pick so update automation receives valid JSON during the 2026.7.2 upgrade path.

options.title: Defer to a later release
options.body: Leave the release branch unchanged and accept that the corrected JSON resume behavior remains available only after upgrading beyond 2026.7.2.

recommendation.title: Include the tested backport
recommendation.body: Merge this exact cherry-pick so update automation receives valid JSON during the 2026.7.2 upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main fix and this release backport are both authored by vincentkoc, making them the strongest available routing contact for the implementation and its release evidence.
